verdict.rationale: Finix's docs say ops users can monitor and act on Disputes through the Dashboard or API, and can upload evidence and submit a response to challenge a Dispute. Dispute management tools and automated dispute reports are also listed. Nothing in the pack shows chargebacks being attributed to the specific sub-merchant or seller, or dispute outcomes automatically adjusting seller balances or payouts. Missing for 10: evidence of per-seller dispute attribution, automatic flow of outcomes into seller balances, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
